decision.explanation: Both awards are directly stated in the provided sources as having been received by Manuel Estrada Pérez. Document D1S2 explicitly states he received the Medal of Francysk Skaryna from Belarus, while D2S2 confirms he was honored with the Knight of the Order of the White Rose of Finland by Finland. These are distinct awards from separate countries and are both valid under the 'other' slot hint.
